title: Trail Crew Member
description: A six-month seasonal trail crew member position, funded by the WRTC and reporting to the US Forest Service Ketchum Ranger District. It is a mostly front-country crew, with several backcountry camping hitches.
duties: Utilizes and services chainsaws and handsaws for brushing and bucking logs and hangups in the trail corridor
Maintains tread and drainage using picks, shovels, and hoes
Operates company trucks and mountain bikes
Hikes up to 10 miles per day to perform trail maintenance
Project work includes rock retainers, bridge construction, and drainage features
